| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Object | Object, Boundaries over the image, Object probability | The object as a label map, drawn over the image and listed in the Features panel. Or its boundary in yellow over the image. Or the probability of the object at each pixel, from black for 0 to white for 1. |
| **Seeds** `seeds` | Selection and image edge | Selection and image edge, Selection as a map | With the selection and image edge, the selected pixels are object seeds and the unselected pixels on the image edge are background seeds. As a map, pixels selected at 192 or more are object seeds, those at 63 or less are background seeds, and partly selected pixels are unknown. |
| **Edge strength** `beta` | 130 | 1 to 2000 | The beta in the edge weights. scikit-image divides it by 10 times the standard deviation of the luma. scikit-image uses 130. |
| **Tolerance** `tolerance` | 0.001 | 1e-05 to 0.1 | When the conjugate gradient solver stops. scikit-image uses 0.001. |
